name: model-runner-request-safe-backend-failover
instr:
Docker Model Runner cannot recover implicitly selected inference requests from backend failures before committing a response. Try compatible configured backends in deterministic preference order, while preserving explicit selection, routing semantics, successful single-backend behavior, and one coherent client response.

Every backend, including Diffusers, llama.cpp, MLX, SGLang, Linux vLLM, and vLLM Metal, must classify structured backend-specific evidence as retryable, terminal, or indeterminate. Shared backend execution returns structured exit, cancellation, startup-phase, and bounded sanitized stderr evidence after cleanup, while leaving retry eligibility to each backend's classifier. Across those backends, unavailable runtimes, interpreters, platforms, binaries, native launches, and pre-commit startup or readiness failures permit replacement, while cancellation and defects in modes, model bundles or parsing, served names, arguments, and speculative or model configuration terminate the request; unsupported Diffusers image execution before startup permits replacement, but DDUF violations are terminal. Stop on success, terminal classification, or response commitment. Explicit selection never fails over. Implicit selection considers only configured backends compatible with the request's format and mode, current platform, and available installation.
